# FDG8027

> DO NOT return snapshot collections from properties. Properties should return live collections.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3.2.1 Snapshots Versus Live Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: a property that returns a copy, such as the result of ToArray or ToList, is a snapshot, but FDG8028 allows a snapshot for a volatile collection, and whether a collection is volatile is what it represents. A property that returns a new array is CA1819's concern (FDG8032).

## From the book

```csharp
public class Directory {
  public Directory(string root);
  public IEnumerable<FileInfo> Files { get {...} } //live collection
}
```

Property getters should be very lightweight operations. Returning a snapshot generally requires creating a copy of an internal collection in an *O*(*n*) operation.
